Ragi Roti and Glucose Spike 📉📈 Is Ragi actually the "magical healthy alternative" we all think it is? We put it to the ultimate Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) test, and the results were absolutely shocking. 🤯 Yesterday, regular wheat (aata) roti gave us a massive spike, leaving us super stressed. So, we tested the exact same weight of Ragi roti today, expecting much safer numbers. We waited a few hours, checked the monitor, and... trust me, you are not ready for this. My spike was a complete record-breaker—it matched the exact same spike I got from drinking straight pineapple juice!  And my mom's graph? It shot up even higher than the regular wheat roti! 📈 My mom used to have diabetes, but she brought it completely under control two years ago by giving up all types of roti. This test proved exactly why. I even pulled out the packets to compare the nutrition labels, and the truth about Ragi's fiber and net carbs compared to regular wheat will surprise you. The numbers don't lie. Watch the video to see the real-time graph and the final numbers! If you are looking for truly healthy, low-spike alternatives, check out my page for recipes like my Tofu Scramble, Gajar Ka Halwa, and Chocolate Pudding. ✅ Next up: We are testing Bajra ki Roti. POV: you finally made soft ragi buns that aren’t dry 👀✨ Eggless, high protein, gluten-free & honestly SO satisfying 🤍 Save this healthy buns recipe! Eggless High-Protein Ragi Buns Ingredients (4 buns) * 1 cup ragi (finger millet) flour * ¼ cup psyllium husk * ¼ cup high-protein Greek yogurt * 1 tsp baking powder or Eno * 1 tsp vinegar, 1 tbsp olive oil * Salt to taste * 1.5 cups water * Seeds / everything bagel seasoning (for topping) ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Method 1. In a mixing bowl, add ragi flour, psyllium husk, Greek yogurt, baking powder (or Eno), salt, vinegar, and water all at once. 2. Mix gently—within a few seconds, the mixture will start thickening into a soft dough-like texture. 3. Line a baking tray with parchment paper. 4. Divide the dough into 4 portions. 5. Lightly oil or wet your hands and shape into buns (the dough is slightly sticky). 6. Place on the tray and sprinkle your favorite seeds or everything bagel seasoning. 7. Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 40 minutes. 8. Once baked, remove and cover with a clean cloth for 15–20 minutes—this step makes them soft and fluffy. For the air fryer: * Preheat at 170°C for 3–5 minutes * Air fry the ragi buns at 170°C for 18–22 minutes #rag#ragibunsa#healthyrecipesg#highproteinu#glutenfreeglessrecipes

Here’s my travel guide for visiting Mt. Rigi the "Queen of the Mountains." Mount Rigi near Lucerne, Switzerland is home to Europe’s oldest mountain railway so getting to the summit by cogwheel train is half the magic. 🚂How to get to Mount Rigi - all completely FREE with your Swiss Travel Pass! ➡️ From Lucerne: boat across Lake Lucerne to Vitznau, then cogwheel train to the top in just 30 minutes ➡️ From Zurich: train to Arth-Goldau, then cogwheel train to Rigi Kulm in under an hour 🚠 Or take the cable car from Weggis to Rigi Kaltbad in just 10 minutes 🗺️ Check the online timetables before you go 🛏️ Where to stay on Mount Rigi Check into @hotelrigikaltbad 1,450m above sea level, with panoramic mountain views and a mineral spa fed straight from the mountain springs. Day passes to the spa are available, but nothing beats an early morning on Mt. Rigi waking up above the clouds, hearing cowbells at sunrise, and finishing with a dip in the mineral water. ✨Things to do on Mount Rigi 🇨🇭Visit the summit Rigi Kulm 🇨🇭Hike the Lake Views Trail from Rigi Kulm to Rigi Staffelhöhe 🇨🇭 Lunch at Michelin-starred Regina Montium @kraeuterhoteledelweiss 🇨🇭 Catch sunset at the Känzeli viewpoint 🇨🇭 Soak in mountain views from every angle 🇨🇭 Dip in the mineral spa at @mineralbadrigikaltbad Your ultimate Mount Rigi Switzerland travel guide - save it, share it, and add it to your Switzerland bucket list! 🏔️ Filmed on an ad-press trip  ———————————————— Rigi, Mt Rigi, Mount Rigi, Mount Rigi Switzerland, Lucerne, Luzern, Lucerne Switzerland, Lucerne food, bucket list, food bucket list, viral food, content creator, travel Switzerland, travel blog, travel foodie, travel in Europe, visit Switzerland, my Switzerland, best places to visit in Switzerland, Switzerland mountain, Michelin Star restaurant, Lucerne restaurants, things to do Lucerne #switzerland  #lucerne #rigi #travelswitzerland #luzern
